# AcreetionOS

> AcreetionOS is a free, open-source, privacy-focused Linux distribution based on Arch Linux featuring a customized Cinnamon desktop. It is an independent, volunteer-run project led by Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift, based in Spokane, WA, USA. No telemetry, repository sovereignty, 80,000+ packages via pacman and the AUR. The project is NOT affiliated with StormOS or any other distribution team.

## Technical facts

- Base: Arch Linux (rolling release)
- Desktop: Cinnamon (optimized)
- Display protocol: X11 (XLibre)
- Audio: Pipewire
- Filesystem: EXT4
- Bootloader: GRUB (installation), systemd-boot/syslinux (live environment)
- Package management: pacman + AUR (80,000+ packages)
- Custom tools: Mingle (Wayland compositor, in development), Gittracker (repository sovereignty monitor), Ermin (Stoat fork)
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0
